text:
Silver Price in 1992
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1992, the LBMA silver price fell 11.2% between 1992-01-31 ($4.13) and 1992-12-31 ($3.67). The highest sampled price was $4.13 in January and the lowest was $3.67 in December. The mean of these observations was $3.92. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
